name: mobile
description: Z8 store app: a Capacitor shell that loads the live web app on iOS and Android.

scripts.build:android: pnpm run sync:android && node scripts/gradlew.ts assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: pnpm run sync:ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
